_about: Dates Carta works out from a letter the user has confirmed, but that the letter itself does not print. Every entry is a rule with a primary or legal-aid source, quoted verbatim in rule_text. The app shows each result as worked out, not printed, and tells the reader to confirm with the county. CLAUDE.md section 16: never invent a deadline rule.
_schema: second_chances[] apply to one confirmed notice and produce one dated item each. expected_letters[] forecast a letter the household should receive next, so Carta can ask whether it came. anchor names the confirmed field the count starts from. offset is days or calendar months. valid_through bounds rules that come from a time-limited waiver, compared against the anchor date.
_translation_todo: The Spanish here is Carta's own, not an official agency translation. CDSS translations of these rules were not reachable from this project (cdss.ca.gov blocks automated requests). A Spanish-speaking reviewer must read every es string before this ships.

second_chances.title: Turn it in and CalFresh may start again
second_chances.title_es: Entréguelo y CalFresh puede volver a empezar
second_chances.en: If your CalFresh stopped because a report, information, or proof was missing, turn it in by this date. Your benefits may start again without a new application.
second_chances.es: Si su CalFresh se detuvo porque faltaba un reporte, información o una prueba, entréguelo antes de esta fecha. Sus beneficios pueden volver a empezar sin una nueva solicitud.
second_chances.condition: Only if your CalFresh period still has at least one month left. Ask your county.
second_chances.condition_es: Solo si a su periodo de CalFresh todavía le queda al menos un mes. Pregunte a su condado.
second_chances.rule_text: The missing report, information, or verification is received by the local office within 30 days of the date the household became ineligible for program benefits. The household has at least one month remaining in the certification period after the effective date of ineligibility. The CDSS has been authorized by the USDA, FNS to continue implementing the Reinstatement Waiver for a period of five years effective July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2027.
second_chances.source_name: Santa Clara County CalFresh program handbook, Reinstatement Waiver
second_chances._why_counted_from_the_stop_date: The handbook counts 30 days from the date the household became ineligible. Carta counts from the printed stop date, which is that date or the day before it, so the date shown is never later than the real one.

second_chances.title: Had a good reason? Tell the county
second_chances.title_es: ¿Tuvo una buena razón? Dígaselo al condado
second_chances.en: If you had a good reason your report was late, like being sick or a mistake by the county, tell the county by this date. After this date you would need to apply again.
second_chances.es: Si tuvo una buena razón para entregar tarde su reporte, como estar enfermo o un error del condado, dígaselo al condado antes de esta fecha. Después de esta fecha tendría que solicitar de nuevo.
second_chances.condition: The county decides if your reason counts.
second_chances.condition_es: El condado decide si su razón cuenta.
second_chances.rule_text: Once a full calendar month has passed since the SAR 7 discontinuance date, the household may not claim good cause and must reapply. [MPP section 63-508.644] Good cause exists when the recipient is suffering from a mental or physical condition, directly attributable to county error, or other extenuating circumstances. [MPP section 40-181.233]
second_chances.source_name: Legal Services of Northern California, CalFresh Guide, citing MPP 63-508.644 and 40-181.233
second_chances.TODO_verify: Confirm MPP 63-508.644 against the regulation text itself. The guide quotes it; the MPP was not opened directly. The count uses one calendar month from the stop date, which is never later than the end of the following month.

second_chances.title: Turn it in and Medi-Cal can pick up with no gap
second_chances.title_es: Entréguelo y Medi-Cal puede seguir sin interrupción
second_chances.en: If your Medi-Cal stopped because a renewal form or information was missing, turn it in by this date. Your coverage can go back to the day it stopped, with no gap, without a new application.
second_chances.es: Si su Medi-Cal se detuvo porque faltaba un formulario de renovación o información, entréguelo antes de esta fecha. Su cobertura puede regresar al día en que se detuvo, sin interrupción y sin una nueva solicitud.
second_chances.condition: Ask your county to confirm your date.
second_chances.condition_es: Pida a su condado que le confirme su fecha.
second_chances.rule_text: Reconsider in a timely manner the eligibility of an individual who is terminated for failure to submit the renewal form or necessary information, if the individual subsequently submits the renewal form within 90 days after the date of termination, or a longer period elected by the State, without requiring a new application. (42 CFR 435.916(a)(3)(iii)) Santa Clara County: Individuals who comply within 90 days of discontinuance must have their case rescinded back to the original discontinuance date with no break in aid.
second_chances.source_name: 42 CFR 435.916(a)(3)(iii); Santa Clara County Medi-Cal handbook, 90-Day Cure Period
second_chances.source_kind: federal regulation and county program handbook

requires_text: within 90 days of the date of this notice
second_chances.title: Missed the hearing deadline? There is a last date
second_chances.title_es: ¿Se le pasó la fecha para pedir una audiencia? Hay una última fecha
second_chances.en: If you missed the date to ask for a state hearing and had a good reason, you can still ask. After this date, a hearing will not be granted.
second_chances.es: Si se le pasó la fecha para pedir una audiencia estatal y tuvo una buena razón, todavía puede pedirla. Después de esta fecha, no se dará una audiencia.
second_chances.condition: The state decides if your reason counts. Ask your county or legal aid.
second_chances.condition_es: El estado decide si su razón cuenta. Pregunte a su condado o a un servicio de ayuda legal.
second_chances.rule_text: A person shall be entitled to a hearing pursuant to this chapter if he or she files the request more than 90 days after the order or action complained of and there is good cause for filing the request beyond the 90-day period. The department shall not grant a request for a hearing for good cause if the request is filed more than 180 days after the order or action complained of. (Welfare and Institutions Code section 10951)
second_chances.source_name: California Welfare and Institutions Code section 10951
second_chances.TODO_verify: The statute counts from 'the order or action complained of'. Carta counts from the notice date, and only when the notice itself says 'within 90 days of the date of this notice'. Confirm with CDSS State Hearings that the notice date is the anchor the division uses.

expected_letters.title: Your CalFresh renewal notice
expected_letters.title_es: Su aviso de renovación de CalFresh
expected_letters.rule_text: The SAR 7 is due on the 5th of the month, in the sixth month after application or recertification. [ACIN I-35-25] The State agency shall provide other households the NOE before the first day of the last month of the certification period, but not before the first day of the next-to-the-last month. (7 CFR 273.14(b)(1)(i))
expected_letters.source_name: 7 CFR 273.14(b)(1)(i); Legal Services of Northern California, CalFresh Guide, citing ACIN I-35-25
expected_letters.source_kind: federal regulation and legal aid guide
expected_letters.TODO_verify: Assumes the usual 12-month CalFresh certification, where the SAR 7 is due in month 6 and the period ends in month 12. Households certified for longer renew later; the app asks 'did it come?' and offers 'not yet, ask me later' for exactly that case.
expected_letters._how_counted: expect_from_month and expect_by_month count calendar months forward from the month of the SAR 7 due date: the notice of expiration arrives on or after the first day of month +5 and before the first day of month +6. Carta asks ask_after_days after that, to allow for the mail.
